Soil_Amendments.Acidic_Soil (pH < 5.5): Apply Agricultural Lime (Calcium Carbonate) or Dolomite at 2-4 tons/ha
Soil_Amendments.Alkaline_Soil (pH > 7.8): Apply Gypsum (Calcium Sulfate) or Elemental Sulfur at 1-2 tons/ha
Soil_Amendments.Organic_Carbon_Depleted: Apply Farm Yard Manure (FYM) or Vermicompost at 5-10 tons/ha
